title: Full Stack Web Development
tagline: From Zero to Full Stack Production Maestro
description: The complete journey from modern JavaScript and React to scalable FastAPI / Node.js backends, MongoDB / PostgreSQL databases, and cloud deployment.
source_attribution: Synthesized from roadmap.sh (Full Stack), freeCodeCamp (Responsive Web & Full Stack), and Boot.dev (Web Dev Core)

stages.title: Stage 1: Web Fundamentals & Modern JavaScript
stages.description: Master the core trio of the web: semantic HTML, modern responsive CSS, and modern ES6+ JavaScript.

topics.title: Semantic HTML & Modern Flexbox/Grid
topics.description: Understand document structure, accessibility, and modern responsive layout engines.

topics.title: Modern JavaScript (ES6+): Closures, Async/Await & APIs
topics.description: Deep-dive into event loops, promises, async/await, fetch API, and destructuring.

stages.title: Stage 2: Frontend Engineering with React & Next.js
stages.description: Build reactive component hierarchies, manage server/client state, and render server-side.

topics.title: React Architecture: Hooks, State & Component Lifecycle
topics.description: Component composition, useState, useEffect, custom hooks, and state immutability.

topics.title: Next.js App Router: Server Components & Data Fetching
topics.description: Server vs Client Components, dynamic routing, metadata SEO, and streaming UI.

stages.title: Stage 3: Scalable Backend & REST API Engineering
stages.description: Design secure RESTful APIs, authenticate users, and manage server business logic.

topics.title: FastAPI & REST Architecture: Routing, Pydantic & Validation
topics.description: Build high-throughput async endpoints, request/response models, and status codes.

topics.title: Authentication & Security: JWT, Password Hashing & RBAC
topics.description: Implement token-based authentication, bcrypt hashing, and protected route guards.

stages.title: Stage 4: Databases, Persistence & Cloud Deployment
stages.description: Store data at scale with MongoDB and SQL, write migrations, and deploy live.

topics.title: MongoDB & Document Databases: Schemas, Aggregations & Indexes
topics.description: Master flexible NoSQL collections, BSON, compounding indexes, and pipeline queries.

topics.title: Containerization & CI/CD: Docker, GitHub Actions & Vercel
topics.description: Package full-stack apps into multi-stage Docker containers and deploy seamlessly.

title: Backend Engineering & System Architecture
tagline: Master Distributed APIs, Databases, Caching & Scalability
description: A comprehensive backend mastery path covering API design, relational & NoSQL databases, caching with Redis, message brokers, and high-concurrency systems.
source_attribution: Synthesized from roadmap.sh (Backend) and Boot.dev (Backend in Go & Python)

stages.title: Stage 1: HTTP Protocols, Network Layers & API Foundations
stages.description: Deep understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2/3, headers, status codes, and idempotency.

topics.title: HTTP In-Depth: Headers, Caching, Methods & Sockets
topics.description: Master HTTP specifications, request lifecycle, TLS handshakes, and CORS headers.

topics.title: RESTful API Standards & OpenAPI / Swagger Specification
topics.description: Design intuitive REST resources, versioning schemes, pagination, and error envelopes.

stages.title: Stage 2: Database Mastery & Query Optimization
stages.description: Relational schemas, ACID transactions, normalization, and NoSQL trade-offs.

topics.title: PostgreSQL & Relational Modeling: Joins, Indexes & Transactions
topics.description: Write complex SQL queries, understand EXPLAIN ANALYZE, and prevent slow table scans.

topics.title: Redis & In-Memory Caching Strategies
topics.description: Implement Cache-Aside, Write-Through, TTL strategies, and rate limiting algorithms.

stages.title: Stage 3: Asynchronous Queues & Microservices
stages.description: Decoupling systems with message queues, background workers, and service meshes.

topics.title: Background Tasks & Message Brokers (RabbitMQ & Kafka)
topics.description: Decouple heavy tasks using producer-consumer queues and idempotent workers.

title: AI & Machine Learning Engineering
tagline: Build Intelligent Systems from Foundations to Modern LLMs
description: Master Python data science, core machine learning algorithms, deep learning with PyTorch, and modern generative AI with LangChain, RAG, and vector databases.
source_attribution: Synthesized from roadmap.sh (AI and Data Science) and freeCodeCamp (Machine Learning with Python)

stages.title: Stage 1: Mathematics & Python for Machine Learning
stages.description: NumPy array vectorization, Pandas data manipulation, and linear algebra fundamentals.

topics.title: NumPy & Pandas: Matrix Operations & Feature Engineering
topics.description: Master broadcasting, vectorized computation, handling missing values, and data cleaning.

topics.title: Classical ML: Regression, Decision Trees & Random Forests
topics.description: Train, evaluate, and tune supervised learning models with scikit-learn.

stages.title: Stage 2: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures
stages.description: Backpropagation, PyTorch tensors, Convolutional Networks, and Transformers.

topics.title: PyTorch Fundamentals: Autograd, Tensors & Training Loops
topics.description: Build neural networks from scratch with forward passes, loss functions, and optimizers.

stages.title: Stage 3: Generative AI, RAG & LLM Agents
stages.description: Embeddings, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous agent loops.

topics.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Databases
topics.description: Chunk documents, generate vector embeddings, query semantic stores, and synthesize context.

title: Frontend & UI/UX Engineering
tagline: Craft World-Class, Fluid, High-Performance Web Applications
description: Specialized path focusing on modern React, state management, animations, accessibility (a11y), Tailwind CSS, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
source_attribution: Synthesized from roadmap.sh (Frontend) and freeCodeCamp (Front End Development Libraries)

stages.title: Stage 1: Advanced CSS, Tailwind & Design Systems
stages.description: Tokens, CSS Grid, animations, dark mode palettes, and responsive typography.

topics.title: Tailwind CSS & Design Tokens: Building Reusable Component Libraries
topics.description: Design systems, atomic classes, dark mode theming, and accessible form controls.

stages.title: Stage 2: State Management & Client Performance
stages.description: Zustand, React Query/TanStack, and optimizing Core Web Vitals.

topics.title: TanStack Query & Client State: Server Cache & Optimistic Updates
topics.description: Master data fetching, automatic caching, deduplication, and optimistic mutations.

title: DevOps & Cloud Architecture
tagline: Automate, Orchestrate and Scale Resilient Cloud Systems
description: Master Linux systems administration, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Terraform Infrastructure as Code, and cloud monitoring.
source_attribution: Synthesized from roadmap.sh (DevOps) and freeCodeCamp (DevOps Bootcamp)

stages.title: Stage 1: Linux Administration & Container Foundations
stages.description: Bash automation, networking, process management, and Docker images.

topics.title: Docker Deep Dive: Multi-Stage Builds, Volumes & Networks
topics.description: Write lean Dockerfiles, isolate network namespaces, and run multi-service Docker Compose.

stages.title: Stage 2: Kubernetes & Continuous Delivery
stages.description: Pods, Deployments, Services, Helm charts, and automated zero-downtime rollouts.

topics.title: Kubernetes Architecture: Pods, Services, Ingress & Helm
topics.description: Orchestrate distributed containers, configure ingress controllers, and scale replicas.

title: Cyber Security & Defensive Engineering
tagline: Defend Networks, Prevent Exploits & Conduct Penetration Testing
description: Learn network packet analysis, OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities, cryptography fundamentals, security auditing, and cloud security compliance.
source_attribution: Synthesized from roadmap.sh (Cyber Security) and freeCodeCamp (Information Security)

stages.title: Stage 1: Web Application Security & OWASP Top 10
stages.description: Understand how attacks happen: Injection, Broken Auth, XSS, and CSRF.

topics.title: OWASP Top 10 Deep Dive: Exploitation & Hardening
topics.description: Hands-on vulnerability analysis: SQL injection, SSRF, Cross-Site Scripting, and defenses.
